$comment: engine.commands reply — a BARE JSON array of command objects, no {"commands": …} wrapper
(plus an optional string `keywords` on commands that have them, e.g. select.rect #5060).
disabledReason is null exactly when enabled is true. needsDocument is true only when the command
is off because no document is open (#3664) — plan around needsDocument, not enabled alone.
This 12-command excerpt is a session with NO document open, so document-bound commands are
disabled with needsDocument true. Every id, label, menu, shortcut and params doc below was
engine revision; tests/drift-check.test.ts alarms when a required id disappears upstream.
The full registry is much larger; the reply is filtered to this excerpt for fixture size.
